PagerDuty Bot: P0 - Smart-routing alert: elevated 5xx + wrong-variant routing detected for customer-facing search endpoints in eu-west. paging @SRE Oncall and @Ravi (ml-infra) :rotating_light:
SRE Oncall: I'm on it, joining call now.
Miguel R.: seeing 5xx jump from 0.2% -> 6.8% in the last 3m, error traces show model mismatch (v2b) on endpoints supposed to be pinned to v2a.
Annie H.: confirmed — the canary rollout started 1769004200 and traffic tiering seems to have routed sessions across regions incorrectly. Some EU sessions got routed to v2b despite config. :eyes:
Ravi (ml-infra): grabbing routing policy logs. Suspect fallback adhesion/affinity setting caused session stickiness to preserve a transient variant assignment. Pulling policy snapshot now.
Ravi (ml-infra): policy snippet from control plane dump:
```
policy {
  name: "smart-route-eu"
  precedence: [latency, cost, canary_weight]
  fallback {
    type: "adhesive"  # sticky-affinity
    ttl_seconds: 600
    allow_variant_mismatch: true
  }
}
```
Ravi (ml-infra): that `allow_variant_mismatch: true` looks wrong for canary. It lets fallback glue sessions to an incompatible variant.
Annie H.: that explains why some sessions keep bouncing to v2b even after we drained canary nodes. If fallback is adhesive we create persistent "adhesion" to the wrong variant when regional routing flips.
SRE Oncall: paging history shows EU-region had a short capacity blip at 1769004255 => routing kicked to fallback. that sticky fallback stuck.
Priya (product): flagged customer-facing impact: search relevance regressions reported by two enterprise customers in EU. CS looped in.
Jared (cust-success): customer A: "search results suddenly worse, hitting older model outputs" — they're seeing degraded quality and longer tail latency ~800ms -> 1.6s.
Miguel R.: request: we should minimize blast radius — pause rollout, revert routing fallback to non-adhesive, and pin stable variant for affected routes.
SRE Oncall: agreed. Actions: 1) Pause canary roll (prevent more targets) 2) Change fallback to non-adhesive 3) Pin v2a for EU route 4) Drain/evict any stuck sessions if needed.
deploy-bot: /deploy pause-rollout --project=search-model --canary=true 
deploy-bot: Rollout paused (id: r-1769004200) :white_check_mark:
Ravi (ml-infra): updating policy to remove adhesion now. patch applied: 
```
PATCH /config/policies/smart-route-eu
{
  "fallback": {"type": "stateless", "ttl_seconds": 30, "allow_variant_mismatch": false}
}
```
Ravi (ml-infra): change pushed, will propagate to control planes in eu-west within ~90s.
Annie H.: once propagation is confirmed, we should pin route to v2a for active sessions: `route.pin --route=search-eu --variant=v2a --ttl=300`
Ravi (ml-infra): running pin now:
```
routectl pin --route search-eu --variant v2a --ttl 300
```
Ravi (ml-infra): pin applied. Confirming backend assignments...
Miguel R.: monitoring errors — 5xx is falling from 6.8% -> 1.7% in the last 2m. Latency for affected customers trending back to baseline.
SRE Oncall: great. Now we need a safe rollback plan if residual issues remain. Prefer to keep canary paused and run a smaller canary next window with stricter policy.
Priya (product): agreed — we'll hold rollout and update the runbook. Product will notify impacted account reps with a short note. Draft message ready, will share.
Jared (cust-success): contacting the two affected customers, offering hotfix window and status updates.
Annie H.: post-incident checklist: 1) revert `allow_variant_mismatch` default in policy templates 2) add automated test that simulates region fallback + canary to catch adhesion behavior 3) add alert that fires when variant != pinned-variant for more than Xs
Ravi (ml-infra): opening PR for policy templates now, and adding unit test in the routing emulator.
SRE Oncall: assigning followups — Ravi to PR and test, Annie to runbook updates, Priya/Jared to customer comms. Oncall will monitor for 30m before closing.
Miguel R.: quick note: no data exfiltration or PII exposure observed. impact is quality/latency only.
Priya (product): posting status update to #status-pages in 5m.
SRE Oncall: thanks all — keeping the incident open for monitoring. will update in 15. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident acknowledged by @SRE Oncall. Severity: P0 -> monitoring, next update at 1769004830."
